Name: EstimatedPlannedActualMonthly
Description: System generic extraction of estimated, planned and actual, per currency, including time, costs, income, profit.
Statement:
select  com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        div.Name as Division,
        dep.Name as Department,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        cli.Oid as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cli.HasImage as ClientHasImage,
        pro.Name as Product,
        prj.Oid as ProjectId,
        prj.Name as Project,
        usl.Id as UserId,
        usl.Name as [User],
        usl.HasImage as UserHasImage,
        ust.Name as UserType,
        datefromparts(year(prj.BeginDate), month(prj.BeginDate), 1) as FromMonth,
        datefromparts(year(prj.EndDate), month(prj.EndDate), 1) as ToMonth,
        datefromparts(year(Month), month(Month), 1) as Month,
        sum(ContractedTime) as ContractedTime,
        sum(PlannedContractedTime) as PlannedContractedTime,
        sum(PlannedTime) as PlannedTime,
        sum(ActualTime) as ActualTime,
        sum(ContractedCost) as ContractedCost,
        sum(PlannedCost) as PlannedCost,
        sum(ActualCost) as ActualCost,
        sum(ContractedIncome) as ContractedIncome,
        sum(PlannedIncome) as PlannedIncome,
        sum(ActualIncome) as ActualIncome,
        sum(ContractedIncome - ContractedCost) as ContractedProfit,
        sum(PlannedIncome - PlannedCost) as PlannedProfit,
        sum(ActualIncome - ActualCost) as ActualProfit,
        sum(ContractedCost * Exchange) as CompanyContractedCost,
        sum(PlannedCost * Exchange) as CompanyPlannedCost,
        sum(ActualCost * Exchange) as CompanyActualCost,
        sum(ContractedIncome * Exchange) as CompanyContractedIncome,
        sum(PlannedIncome * Exchange) as CompanyPlannedIncome,
        sum(ActualIncome * Exchange) as CompanyActualIncome,
        sum((ContractedIncome - ContractedCost) * Exchange) as CompanyContractedProfit,
        sum((PlannedIncome - PlannedCost) * Exchange) as CompanyPlannedProfit,
        sum((ActualIncome - ActualCost) * Exchange) as CompanyActualProfit,
        max(Exchange) as Exchange,
        max(cur.Symbol) as CurrencySymbol,
        prc.Name as CurrencyCompany,
        ccr.Symbol as CurrencyCompanySymbol
from    Company com, Division div, Department dep, UserTypologyGroup utg, Currency cur, Currency ccr, Project prj, Company prc,
        (
            select	est.Client,
                    est.Project,
                    eid.Department,
                    eid.UserTypologyGroup,
                    eid.[User],
                    est.Product as Product,
                    eid.Oid as EstimateItemDetail,
                    est.Currency, 
                    max(est.Exchange) as Exchange,
                    sum(edm.Hours) as ContractedTime,
                    0 as PlannedContractedTime,
                    0 as PlannedTime,
                    0 as ActualTime,
                    sum(eid.UnitPriceCost * edm.Hours) as ContractedCost,
                    0 as PlannedCost,
                    0 as ActualCost,
                    sum(eid.UnitPriceIncome * edm.Hours) as ContractedIncome,
                    0 as PlannedIncome,
                    0 as ActualIncome,
                    edm.DateUtc as Month
            from 	EstimateItem eit, EstimateItemDetail eid, EstimateItemDetailMonth edm, Estimate est, JobType typ, WorkflowState wfs, WorkflowStateType wst
            where	eit.Estimate = est.Oid and
                    eit.Oid = eid.EstimateItem and
                    edm.EstimateItemDetail = eid.Oid and
                    wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
                    wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType and
                    typ.Oid = est.JobType and
                    typ.Name != 'Budget' and
                    wst.Status not in (1, 7) and
                    est.Project is not null
            group by est.Client, est.Project, eid.Department, eid.UserTypologyGroup, eid.[User], est.Product, edm.DateUtc, est.Currency, eid.Oid
            union all
            select	prj.Client,
                    prj.Id,
                    eid.Department,
                    phd.UserTypologyGroup,
                    phd.[User],
                    prj.Product as Product,
                    eid.Oid as EstimateItemDetail,
                    est.Currency, 
                    max(est.Exchange) as Exchange,
                    0 as ContractedTime,
                    sum((phd.ContractedMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours) as PlannedContractedTime,
                    sum((AdjustmentMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours) as PlannedTime,
                    0 as ActualTime,
                    0 as ContractedCost,
                    sum((AdjustmentMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours * pnh.SellRate) as PlannedCost,
                    0 as ActualCost,
                    0 as ContractedIncome,
                    sum((AdjustmentMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours * pnh.SellRate) as PlannedIncome,
                    0 as ActualIncome,
                    phd.Date as Month
            from 	PlannedHoursDeliverableTotal pnh, PlannedHoursDeliverableAdjustment phd, EstimateItemDetail eid, EstimateItem eit, Estimate est, 
                    ProjectLookup prj, Department dep, Division div, Company com 
            where	prj.Id = phd.Project and
                    pnh.Project = prj.Id and
                    pnh.UserTypologyGroup = phd.UserTypologyGroup and
                    pnh.[User] = phd.[User] and
                    eit.Oid = eid.EstimateItem and
                    est.Oid = eit.Estimate and
                    eid.Oid = pnh.EstimateItemDetail and
                    eid.Oid = phd.EstimateItemDetail and
                    dep.Oid = eid.Department and
                    div.Oid = dep.Division and
                    com.Oid = div.Company and
                    pnh.GCRecord is null and
                    phd.GCRecord is null and
                    exists 
                    (
                        select  1
                        from    Estimate est, WorkflowState wfs, WorkflowStateType wst
                        where   est.Project = prj.Id and
                                wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
                                wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType and
                                wst.Status not in (1, 7)
                    ) and
                    phd.Project is not null
            group by prj.Client, prj.Id, eid.Department, phd.UserTypologyGroup, phd.[User], prj.Product, phd.Date, eid.Oid, est.Currency
            union all
            select	Client,
                    Project,
					CreatedByDepartment as Department,
					tpl.UserTypologyGroup,
					tim.CreatedBy as [User],
                    tim.Product,
                    null as EstimateItemDetail,
                    com.Currency,
                    1 as Exchange,
					0 as ContractedTime,
                    0 as PlannedContractedTime,
                    0 as PlannedTime,
                    sum((tim.DurationHours + tim.DurationMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours) as ActualTime,
                    0 as ContractedCost,
                    0 as PlannedCost,
                    sum((tim.DurationHours + tim.DurationMinutes / 60.0) / com.RequiredHours * Tim.HourlyUserCost) as ActualCost,
                    0 as ContractedIncome,
                    0 as PlannedIncome,
					0 as ActualIncome,
                    datefromparts(year(tim.Date), month(tim.Date), 1) as Month
			from 	Timesheet tim, UserTypology tpl, Company com
			where	tpl.Oid = tim.CreatedByTypology and
                    com.Oid = tim.Company and
                    tim.Project is not null
            group by Client, Project, tim.CreatedByDepartment, tpl.UserTypologyGroup, tim.CreatedBy, tim.Product, datefromparts(year(tim.Date), month(tim.Date), 1), com.Currency
        ) t
			left join CommercialClient cli on cli.Oid = t.Client
			left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = t.Product
            left join UserLookUp usl on usl.Id = t.[User]
            left join UserType ust on ust.Oid = usl.UserType
where   dep.Oid = t.Department and
        div.Oid = dep.Division and
        com.Oid = div.Company and
        utg.Oid = t.UserTypologyGroup and
        cur.Oid = t.Currency and
        prc.Oid = prj.Company and
        ccr.Oid = prc.Currency and
        prj.Oid = t.Project
group by com.Oid, com.Name, prj.Oid, prj.Name, com.HasImage, div.Name, dep.Name, dep.Oid, utg.Name, utg.Oid, cli.Oid, cli.Name, cli.HasImage, pro.Name, Month, usl.Id,
        usl.Name, usl.HasImage, ust.Name, prj.BeginDate, prj.EndDate, t.EstimateItemDetail, ccr.Symbol, prc.Name
